tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0023 1. Lemma 1.16\group homogeneous-ricci-flow

Suppose that $\{ F_i\} $ is a Milnor frame for a left-invariant metric on a $3$-dimensional unimodular Lie group $G$. Then $\langle R(F_k,F_i)F_j,F_k\rangle = 0$ for all $k$ and any $i\neq j$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0023 \sketch Using the Milnor-frame formulas for $\ad ^*$ and the Levi-Civita connection, the mixed curvature component reduces to a product of orthogonal vectors, hence vanishes.

□
